text:
**My pick for most people is the Anker 735 (Nano II 65W).** It gives a laptop the full 65W from one port and still has room for a phone.

## Top picks

**1. Anker 735 Charger (Nano II 65W), $29.99** ([Newegg](https://www.newegg.com/p/359-00D8-002C3))
- It has 2 USB-C ports and 1 USB-A. A single device gets 65W from either USB-C port.
- With two devices, the split is 45W + 20W. With all three, it drops to 40W / 12W / 12W.
- It's about the size of an AirPods Pro case, with a foldable plug, an 18-month warranty and PPS support per [Anker's spec page](https://service.anker.com/product-description/a085g000004x2BVAAY).
- One caution: Laptopbee's [roundup](https://www.laptopbee.com/best-65w-usb-c-chargers/) says Anker's 3-port 65W lacks PPS for Samsung Super Fast Charging. Anker's own spec lists PPS, so check this if you have a Galaxy phone.

**2. UGREEN Nexode Pro 65W** (price not in the results; [review](https://smartgadgetkit.com/best-gan-charger/))
- Smart Gadget Kit picked it as best overall. It delivers a verified 65W from one port, has three ports, weighs 113g, and includes US, UK and EU plug heads.
- With two devices connected, the split is 45W + 20W. The USB-A port tops out at 22.5W.
- Laptopbee's [65W roundup](https://www.laptopbee.com/best-65w-usb-c-chargers/) also lists a UGREEN Nexode 65W as its best-value pick.

**3. Baseus Enercore (67W), $29.99** ([Tom's Hardware review](https://www.tomshardware.com/peripherals/usb/best-usb-chargers))
- Tom's Hardware named it the best 65W-range charger. It held full wattage throughout testing and ran the coolest of the group.
- It has a built-in retractable USB-C cable plus two more USB-C ports, which is handy for travel.

## If you have a Galaxy phone
The **Baseus GaN5 Pro 65W** has PPS for Samsung fast charging. It's sold as a 2-pack for $49.99 (list $59.99), which suits a home charger plus one for your bag. When several devices are connected, the laptop port drops to 45W, which is fine for a MacBook Air but slower for a true 65W laptop. [Buy at Baseus via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-gan5-pro-65w-2c-u). This is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission at no cost to you. The [product page](https://dealectric.com/baseus-gan5-pro-65w-2c-u) has the details.

## Tips
- Plug your laptop into the main USB-C port, since the phone port gets the smaller share.
- None of these include a cable. Get a USB-C cable rated for 60W or more.
- If you have a 14" or 16" MacBook Pro or a gaming laptop, 65W will charge slowly under load. Consider a 100W charger instead.
